04 / HOW IT HOLDS TOGETHERCOLOUR → ROLE → APPLICATION
01

Keep the charcoal.

Very gently tinted neutrals give each flavour its atmosphere. The accent gets to shine because the rest knows when to be quiet.

02

Give colour a job.

One lead accent for interaction. Supporting hues for syntax, categories and status. A green success stays green when the interface turns pink.

03

Make it readable.

Dark labels on bright buttons. Clear foregrounds on raised surfaces. 21 selected contrast pairs checked per flavour, with no claim of a complete accessibility audit.
